About This Workshop

Learn the fundamentals and advanced techniques of data science and analytics. This session covers Python programming for data analysis, data visualization with libraries like Matplotlib and Seaborn, statistical analysis, and introduction to machine learning models. Perfect for both beginners and intermediate learners.
